prompt: Song implements Comparable<Song>: implement compareTo so songs sort by seconds ascending, breaking ties by title alphabetically.
explanation: Comparable's compareTo defines the natural ordering that Arrays.sort uses. Integer.compare is safer than subtracting the two fields because subtraction can overflow for extreme values. Returning the primary comparison whenever it is non-zero and delegating to String.compareTo only on ties produces the ascending-by-seconds, alphabetical-tie-break ordering the tests expect.
hints: Compare durations first: Integer.compare(seconds, other.seconds) yields a negative, zero, or positive result.
Only when the seconds comparison is 0 should the titles decide; String already implements alphabetical compareTo.
Return the non-zero primary result immediately, and fall through to the title comparison only on a tie.
